title: Title

title: Armory
caption: The weapon racks: unlock with scrap, equip one weapon for each hero. The panel shows the passive and the starter-deck swap.

title: Shift Change
caption: The run-start bonus: pick one of three.

title: Map

caption: A kill on a Staggered zombie: the slow-motion finisher.

caption: The Shield Guard at the security gate.
